projeto: Lovable 'Time Barra Mobiliza' c85dc756-de03-4968-ae04-54ae96a67671 (GitHub Thur-zi/time-barra-unity; preview https://id-preview--c85dc756-de03-4968-ae04-54ae96a67671.lovable.app)
observacoes: These are the official colors from the brand manual (Manual de Marca 2026) cited in styles.css: green #018b27, dark green #018022, gold #f0aa02, blue #06126a. Extra tones: primary-deep #0a5c1c, primary-darker #043d12 (sidebar). The hero uses a green gradient (#018b27 to #0a5c1c) with white text and a gold CTA (#f0aa02, text #2a1e00-ish). Barlow Condensed is the condensed font. logo-time-barra-white.png (white on transparent) is for dark/green backgrounds. Both logos were converted from WebP to PNG. The 'Time Barra Groups' project (f6f4f6d2) uses an older approximate palette (#046A38/#FFC629/#0033A0, font Archivo) and was not used.
